en: Determine a company’s tax residence and scope of income
Compute chargeable income from profit before tax
Identify gross business income and allowable, specific, double and prohibited deductions
Apply the carry-forward limits for capital allowances and losses
Apply approved donation rules and the corporate tax rates
ms: Tentukan residen cukai syarikat dan skop pendapatan
Hitung pendapatan bercukai daripada keuntungan sebelum cukai
Kenal pasti pendapatan kasar perniagaan serta potongan dibenarkan, khusus, berganda dan dilarang
Gunakan had bawa ke hadapan bagi elaun modal dan kerugian
Gunakan peraturan derma diluluskan dan kadar cukai korporat

blocks.en: Corporate tax is imposed on resident companies (private and public limited) that earn income in Malaysia and from outside Malaysia.
blocks.ms: Cukai korporat dikenakan ke atas syarikat residen (berhad dan sendirian berhad) yang memperoleh pendapatan di Malaysia dan dari luar Malaysia.

blocks.en: A company is tax resident in Malaysia if its management and control are exercised in Malaysia, normally where the directors’ meetings on management and control are held.
blocks.ms: Syarikat ialah residen cukai Malaysia jika pengurusan dan kawalannya dijalankan di Malaysia, lazimnya di tempat mesyuarat pengarah mengenai pengurusan dan kawalan diadakan.

blocks.en: Foreign-source income
blocks.ms: Pendapatan sumber luar negara

en: From 1 January 2022, income derived from foreign sources and received in Malaysia is taxed in the hands of Malaysian residents
The Schedule 6 para 28 exemption applies only to non-residents
Of foreign income received in Malaysia, the exempt item is foreign dividend income received in Malaysia by a resident company [P.U.(A) 235/2022]
ms: Dari 1 Januari 2022, pendapatan sumber luar negara yang diterima di Malaysia dicukai ke atas residen Malaysia
Pengecualian Jadual 6 para 28 hanya terpakai kepada bukan residen
Pendapatan dividen luar negara yang diterima di Malaysia oleh syarikat residen ialah pendapatan luar negara diterima di Malaysia yang layak dikecualikan [P.U.(A) 235/2022]

blocks.en: Form C: the company return form (slide 6)
blocks.ms: Borang C: borang nyata cukai syarikat (slaid 6)

blocks.en: Slide 6 shows Form C (CP5, YA2025), the return form under section 77A. Its Basic Particulars section asks:
blocks.ms: Slaid 6 menunjukkan Borang C (CP5, YA2025), borang nyata di bawah seksyen 77A. Bahagian Butiran Asas bertanya:

en: Name of company, registration no., Tax Identification No. (TIN, prefix C)
ms: Nama syarikat, no. pendaftaran, No. Pengenalan Cukai (TIN, awalan C)

en: Incorporated in Malaysia (1 = Yes, 2 = No); country of residence
ms: Diperbadankan di Malaysia (1 = Ya, 2 = Tidak); negara residen

en: Status of business: 1 = in operation, 2 = dormant, 3 = in the process of winding up; commencement date of operations
ms: Status perniagaan: 1 = beroperasi, 2 = tidak aktif, 3 = dalam proses pembubaran; tarikh mula operasi

en: Accounting period and basis period (from and to dates)
ms: Tempoh perakaunan dan tempoh asas (dari dan hingga)

en: SME test: paid-up ordinary share capital not above RM2.5 million at the start of the basis period, gross income from all business sources not above RM50 million, and the requirements of paragraphs 2B and 2C, Part 1, Schedule 1 fulfilled
ms: Ujian PKS: modal saham biasa berbayar tidak melebihi RM2.5 juta pada awal tempoh asas, pendapatan kasar semua sumber perniagaan tidak melebihi RM50 juta, dan syarat perenggan 2B dan 2C, Bahagian 1, Jadual 1 dipenuhi

en: Asset-backed securities company; company limited by guarantee; controlled company; foreign company without share capital; Federal/State statutory body; permanent establishment in Malaysia
ms: Syarikat sekuriti disokong aset; syarikat berhad menurut jaminan; syarikat terkawal; syarikat asing tanpa modal saham; badan berkanun Persekutuan/Negeri; pertubuhan tetap di Malaysia

en: Substantial change in shareholding and subsection 44(5A) applies (1 = Yes, 2 = No, 3 = Not relevant)
ms: Perubahan besar pemegangan saham dan subseksyen 44(5A) terpakai (1 = Ya, 2 = Tidak, 3 = Tidak berkaitan)

en: Claim or surrender of loss under group relief (1 = Claim, 2 = Surrender); claiming uses Form C (RK-T), surrendering uses Form C (RK-S)
ms: Tuntut atau serah kerugian di bawah pelepasan kumpulan (1 = Tuntut, 2 = Serah); tuntutan guna Borang C (RK-T), serahan guna Borang C (RK-S)

blocks.en: Item 12 is why the SME status on this slide matters: it links to the SME tax rates in the Tax Rates section.
blocks.ms: Item 12 ialah sebab status PKS penting: ia berkait dengan kadar cukai PKS dalam bahagian Kadar Cukai.

blocks.en: Lecturer’s Eco Furniture answer (b): advantages of residence status include access to the SME rates of 15% and 17% (non-residents pay 24%), and tax incentives under the ITA and Promotion of Investments Act (not available to non-residents).
blocks.ms: Jawapan Eco Furniture pensyarah (b): kelebihan status residen termasuk akses kepada kadar PKS 15% dan 17% (bukan residen bayar 24%), dan insentif cukai di bawah ITA dan Akta Penggalakan Pelaburan (tidak tersedia kepada bukan residen).

blocks.en: There are two ways to start the computation. Slide 4 shows both: begin from gross income, or begin from the net profit in the accounts. Both reach the same adjusted income.
blocks.ms: Ada dua cara memulakan pengiraan. Slaid 4 menunjukkan kedua-duanya: mula daripada pendapatan kasar, atau mula daripada keuntungan bersih dalam akaun. Kedua-duanya sampai kepada pendapatan diselaraskan yang sama.

en: Net profit before tax in the accounts
ms: Keuntungan bersih sebelum cukai dalam akaun

en: Deduct allowable expenses, double deduction expenses and special deductions (s34, 34A, 34B, 34C and 34D ITA 1967)
Add non-allowable expenses; deduct non-business income, double deduction and special deduction
ms: Tolak perbelanjaan dibenarkan, perbelanjaan potongan berganda dan potongan khas (s34, 34A, 34B, 34C dan 34D ITA 1967)
Tambah perbelanjaan tidak dibenarkan; tolak pendapatan bukan perniagaan, potongan berganda dan potongan khas

blocks.en: Method 2 is the one used in the examination answers, because the accounts have already deducted the expenses and you only correct them. Method 1 builds the figure up from the gross income. Whichever you use, then follow the same steps below.
blocks.ms: Kaedah 2 ialah yang digunakan dalam jawapan peperiksaan, kerana akaun sudah menolak perbelanjaan dan anda hanya membetulkannya. Kaedah 1 membina angka daripada pendapatan kasar. Kaedah mana pun, ikut langkah yang sama di bawah.

en: Add balancing charges; deduct capital allowance / balancing allowances = adjusted income
Deduct brought-forward business losses; add other statutory income = aggregate income (after statutory income)
Deduct current-year business loss, pre-operational expenditure, approved donations, zakat (business) = total / chargeable income
ms: Tambah caj imbangan; tolak elaun modal / elaun imbangan = pendapatan diselaraskan
Tolak kerugian perniagaan dibawa ke hadapan; tambah pendapatan berkanun lain = pendapatan agregat (selepas pendapatan berkanun)
Tolak kerugian perniagaan tahun semasa, perbelanjaan pra-operasi, derma diluluskan, zakat (perniagaan) = jumlah / pendapatan bercukai

blocks.en: Sources of income: section 4 ITA (4a to 4e)
blocks.ms: Punca pendapatan: seksyen 4 ITA (4a hingga 4e)

en: Where it appears in the computation
Business (gains or profits from a business)
Employment (gains or profits from an employment)
Other statutory income (box 3). Dividends are mostly exempt; interest not earned in the course of business is taxed here
ms: Pendapatan berkanun lain (kotak 3). Dividen kebanyakannya dikecualikan; faedah yang bukan dalam perjalanan perniagaan dicukai di sini

en: Rent, royalties, premiums or other profits from property (rental)
Other statutory income (box 3), for example the Brunei rental in the Styles question
ms: Sewa, royalti, premium atau keuntungan lain daripada harta (sewa)
Pendapatan berkanun lain (kotak 3), contohnya sewa Brunei dalam soalan Styles

en: Pensions, annuities or other periodical payments (annuity)
ms: Pencen, anuiti atau bayaran berkala lain (anuiti)

blocks.en: 4(d) rental and 4(e) annuity are from your lecturer. The wording of 4(a) to 4(c) is my general knowledge of section 4, and the course slides do not list it; confirm 4(c) with your lecturer. Statutory income from other sources, in box 3 of slide 4, means the sources 4(c), 4(d) and 4(e).
blocks.ms: 4(d) sewa dan 4(e) anuiti daripada pensyarah anda. Perkataan 4(a) hingga 4(c) ialah pengetahuan am saya tentang seksyen 4, dan slaid kursus tidak menyenaraikannya; sahkan 4(c) dengan pensyarah. Pendapatan berkanun daripada sumber lain, dalam kotak 3 slaid 4, bermaksud punca 4(c), 4(d) dan 4(e).

blocks.en: Slide 4 shows these items in several jumbled boxes. I arranged them to match the order used in the lecturer’s worked answers (adjusted income → statutory income → aggregate income → chargeable income). Treat my ordering as a study aid.
blocks.ms: Slaid 4 menunjukkan item ini dalam beberapa kotak bercampur. Saya susun mengikut urutan jawapan kerja pensyarah (pendapatan diselaraskan → pendapatan berkanun → pendapatan agregat → pendapatan bercukai). Anggap susunan saya sebagai bahan bantu belajar.

blocks.en: Eco Furniture (lecturer’s answer as given; my corrected figure is RM3,921,504 in Worked Examples): adjusted income RM15,540,600 − capital allowance b/f 25,000 − current 120,000 = statutory business income 15,395,600; − losses b/f 20,000 = 15,375,600; + interest 795,000 (dividend exempt) = aggregate income 16,170,600; − donation 15,000 = chargeable income 16,155,600; tax at 24% = RM3,877,344.
blocks.ms: Eco Furniture (jawapan pensyarah seperti diberi; angka betul saya RM3,921,504 dalam Contoh Kerja): pendapatan diselaraskan RM15,540,600 − elaun modal b/h 25,000 − semasa 120,000 = pendapatan berkanun perniagaan 15,395,600; − kerugian b/h 20,000 = 15,375,600; + faedah 795,000 (dividen dikecualikan) = pendapatan agregat 16,170,600; − derma 15,000 = pendapatan bercukai 16,155,600; cukai pada 24% = RM3,877,344.

title.en: Gross Income from a Business Source

blocks.en: Gross income is under sections 22–32 ITA. Business gross income includes:
blocks.ms: Pendapatan kasar di bawah seksyen 22–32 ITA. Pendapatan kasar perniagaan termasuk:

en: Debts for goods sold or services rendered, or property dealt with, in the course of business
Advance payments received for services to be rendered or use of property to be dealt with
Recovery of debts written off where a deduction was made in the adjusted income
Receipts in cash for goods sold or services rendered
Recoveries of business losses (insurance, employee agreement, legal action, other recovery) that were allowed in computing adjusted income (PR 4/2012)
Debts released where a deduction was made in an earlier YA
ms: Hutang bagi barangan dijual atau perkhidmatan diberi, atau harta diurus, dalam perjalanan perniagaan
Bayaran pendahuluan diterima bagi perkhidmatan yang akan diberi atau penggunaan harta yang akan diurus
Perolehan semula hutang yang dihapus kira apabila potongan telah dibuat dalam pendapatan diselaraskan
Penerimaan tunai bagi barangan dijual atau perkhidmatan diberi
Perolehan semula kerugian perniagaan (insurans, perjanjian pekerja, tindakan undang-undang, perolehan lain) yang dibenarkan dalam pendapatan diselaraskan (PR 4/2012)
Hutang dilepaskan apabila potongan dibuat dalam YA terdahulu

title.en: Deductions: S33, S34 and Double Deduction
title.ms: Potongan: S33, S34 dan Potongan Berganda

blocks.en: General provision (S33(1))
blocks.ms: Peruntukan am (S33(1))

blocks.en: Slide 11 gives the general test for a deduction. An expense is deductible under s33(1) only if it passes all five parts; failing any one part means no deduction, whatever the amount.
blocks.ms: Slaid 11 memberi ujian am bagi potongan. Perbelanjaan boleh ditolak di bawah s33(1) hanya jika ia lulus kelima-lima bahagian; gagal satu bahagian bermakna tiada potongan, berapa pun jumlahnya.

en: A real payment or cost of the business, a revenue cost rather than the purchase of a lasting asset (capital)
Air-conditioner installation and the hire purchase agreement fee (Golden Circle) are capital, so they are added back
ms: Bayaran atau kos sebenar perniagaan, kos hasil dan bukan pembelian aset berpanjangan (modal)
Pemasangan penyaman udara dan yuran perjanjian sewa beli (Golden Circle) ialah modal, jadi ditambah balik

en: Spent only for the business, with no private or other purpose. If part is private, that part is not deductible
Entertainment for a potential customer, a wedding gift for a customer, or a cash contribution to a customer’s dinner (PR 4/2015); embezzlement by a director (PR 4/2012 para 7.2.2)
ms: Dibelanjakan hanya untuk perniagaan, tanpa tujuan peribadi atau lain. Jika sebahagian peribadi, bahagian itu tidak boleh ditolak
Keraian bakal pelanggan, hadiah perkahwinan pelanggan, atau sumbangan tunai untuk makan malam pelanggan (PR 4/2015); penyelewengan oleh pengarah (PR 4/2012 para 7.2.2)

en: The cost has actually been incurred, meaning a liability to pay exists. A provision or estimate for a future cost is not yet incurred
The 0.8% maintenance provision and the general provision for bad debts are not incurred (Styles, Health Best)
ms: Kos benar-benar ditanggung, iaitu liabiliti untuk membayar wujud. Peruntukan atau anggaran kos masa depan belum ditanggung
Peruntukan penyelenggaraan 0.8% dan peruntukan am hutang lapuk belum ditanggung (Styles, Health Best)

en: The expense belongs to the basis period of the year of assessment. Costs paid in advance are spread over the period they cover; costs before the business starts are only deductible as the law allows
Rent paid in advance for 16 months: only 2 months fall in the year (Styles). Pre-operating costs follow the commencement date (PR 11/2013)
ms: Perbelanjaan milik tempoh asas bagi tahun taksiran. Kos dibayar awal dibahagi mengikut tempoh yang dilindungi; kos sebelum perniagaan bermula hanya boleh ditolak seperti yang dibenarkan undang-undang
Sewa dibayar awal 16 bulan: hanya 2 bulan jatuh dalam tahun itu (Styles). Kos pra-operasi ikut tarikh permulaan (PR 11/2013)

en: There must be a link between the expense and gross income of the business. Spending that earns no taxable income, or is a gift, is not deductible
Interest on a loan to buy shares whose dividend is exempt (Health Best); a donation to a political party (Styles, Eco)
ms: Mesti ada kaitan antara perbelanjaan dan pendapatan kasar perniagaan. Perbelanjaan yang tidak menghasilkan pendapatan boleh cukai, atau derma, tidak boleh ditolak
Faedah pinjaman membeli saham yang dividennya dikecualikan (Health Best); derma kepada parti politik (Styles, Eco)

blocks.en: Passing s33(1) is not the end. The expense must also not be prohibited by s39(1) (for example private expenses, capital, fines, 50% of entertainment) and, for specific items, the special rules of s34 apply. The five-part reading above is my explanation of the slide, using examples from your worked questions.
blocks.ms: Lulus s33(1) bukan penghujung. Perbelanjaan juga mesti tidak dilarang oleh s39(1) (contohnya perbelanjaan peribadi, modal, denda, 50% keraian) dan, bagi item tertentu, peraturan khas s34 terpakai. Huraian lima bahagian di atas ialah penjelasan saya tentang slaid, dengan contoh daripada soalan kerja anda.

blocks.en: Items allowed under S33(1)
blocks.ms: Item dibenarkan di bawah S33(1)

en: Interest on loans or overdrafts used solely for business or to buy business assets
Rent of land or buildings occupied for the business
Repairs of premises, plant, machinery or fixtures, and renewal, repair or alteration of implements, excluding the cost of reconstructing or rebuilding premises of a permanent nature
ms: Faedah pinjaman atau overdraf yang digunakan semata-mata untuk perniagaan atau membeli aset perniagaan
Sewa tanah atau bangunan yang diduduki untuk perniagaan
Pembaikan premis, loji, jentera atau lekapan, dan pembaharuan, pembaikan atau ubahan perkakas, tidak termasuk kos membina semula premis yang bersifat kekal

blocks.en: Specific deductions (S34)
blocks.ms: Potongan khusus (S34)

en: Irrecoverable bad debts written off and specific doubtful trade debts
ms: Hutang lapuk tidak boleh dipungut yang dihapus kira dan hutang ragu khusus perdagangan

en: Employer’s contributions to approved funds or schemes, ceiling 19% of the employee’s remuneration
ms: Caruman majikan kepada dana atau skim diluluskan, had 19% daripada saraan pekerja

en: Equipment, or alteration or renovation of premises, necessary to help disabled employees perform duties
ms: Peralatan, atau ubahan atau pengubahsuaian premis, yang perlu bagi membantu pekerja kurang upaya menjalankan tugas

en: Translation into or publication in the national language
ms: Terjemahan ke atau penerbitan dalam bahasa kebangsaan

en: Library facilities accessible to the public, not exceeding RM100,000
ms: Kemudahan perpustakaan yang boleh diakses orang awam, tidak melebihi RM100,000

en: Revenue R&D (not capital) related to the business, undertaken by the person or on their behalf
No PR label on the slide
ms: R&D hasil (bukan modal) berkaitan perniagaan, dijalankan oleh orang itu atau bagi pihaknya

en: Provision and maintenance of a child care centre for employees
ms: Penyediaan dan penyelenggaraan pusat jagaan kanak-kanak untuk pekerja

en: Establishing and managing a musical or cultural group approved by the Minister of Finance
ms: Menubuh dan mengurus kumpulan muzik atau kebudayaan diluluskan Menteri Kewangan

en: Sponsorship of arts, cultural and heritage activities in Malaysia up to RM1,000,000; within it, foreign activities remain up to RM300,000 a year
ms: Tajaan aktiviti seni, budaya dan warisan di Malaysia sehingga RM1,000,000; dalamnya, aktiviti luar negara kekal sehingga RM300,000 setahun

en: Practical training for a resident individual who is not an employee
ms: Latihan amali bagi individu residen yang bukan pekerja

blocks.en: Double deduction (S34, 34A, 34B)
blocks.ms: Potongan berganda (S34, 34A, 34B)

blocks.en: Revenue R&D expenditure approved by the Minister of Finance gets a double deduction. A double deduction is also allowed for a resident’s revenue expenditure on a cash contribution to an approved research institute, payment for the services of an approved research institute or approved research company, or payment for the services of an R&D company or contract R&D company (PR 5/2020).
blocks.ms: Perbelanjaan hasil R&D yang diluluskan Menteri Kewangan mendapat potongan berganda. Potongan berganda juga dibenarkan bagi perbelanjaan hasil residen untuk sumbangan tunai kepada institusi penyelidikan diluluskan, bayaran bagi perkhidmatan institusi atau syarikat penyelidikan diluluskan, atau bayaran bagi perkhidmatan syarikat R&D atau syarikat R&D kontrak (PR 5/2020).

en: S34 and S34A (left side of slide 15): revenue R&D directly undertaken by the person or on their behalf, and revenue R&D approved by the Minister of Finance, which gets a double deduction

S34B (right side): double deduction for a Malaysian resident’s revenue expenditure on a cash contribution to an approved research institute, payment for the services of an approved research institute or approved research company, or payment for the services of an R&D company or contract R&D company (PR 5/2020)
ms: S34 dan S34A (sebelah kiri slaid 15): R&D hasil yang dijalankan sendiri atau bagi pihaknya, dan R&D hasil diluluskan Menteri Kewangan yang mendapat potongan berganda

S34B (sebelah kanan): potongan berganda bagi perbelanjaan hasil residen Malaysia untuk sumbangan tunai kepada institut penyelidikan diluluskan, bayaran bagi perkhidmatan institut atau syarikat penyelidikan diluluskan, atau bayaran bagi perkhidmatan syarikat R&D atau syarikat R&D kontrak (PR 5/2020)

en: (b) Not wholly and exclusively incurred to earn income
ms: (b) Tidak ditanggung sepenuhnya dan semata-mata untuk memperoleh pendapatan

en: (c) Capital withdrawn or sums used as capital
e.g. purchase of fixed assets, private residence, cars, shares
ms: (c) Modal yang dikeluarkan atau jumlah digunakan sebagai modal
cth. pembelian aset tetap, rumah persendirian, kereta, saham

en: (d) Payments to a non-approved pension / provident fund
ms: (d) Bayaran kepada dana pencen / simpanan tidak diluluskan

en: (f) Interest or royalty subject to s109 paid to a non-resident without withholding tax paid on time
Also payments under ss109B / 109F without tax deducted and paid in time
ms: (f) Faedah atau royalti tertakluk s109 dibayar kepada bukan residen tanpa cukai pegangan dibayar tepat masa
Juga bayaran di bawah s109B / 109F tanpa cukai ditolak dan dibayar tepat masa

en: (i) Sums paid to a government for a licence to extract timber from a forest in Malaysia
ms: (i) Jumlah dibayar kepada kerajaan untuk lesen mengeluarkan balak dari hutan di Malaysia

en: (j) Contract payment where s107A withholding tax and penalty has not been paid
ms: (j) Bayaran kontrak apabila cukai pegangan s107A dan penalti belum dibayar

en: Above RM100,000 if the vehicle is brand new and costs not more than RM150,000; commercial transport vehicles excluded
ms: Melebihi RM100,000 jika kenderaan baru dan kosnya tidak melebihi RM150,000; kenderaan pengangkutan komersial dikecualikan

en: 100% allowed for the provisos (i)–(viii), e.g. entertainment of employees (annual dinner, outings, family day), entertainment sold in the ordinary course of business, promotional samples, trade-fair gifts outside Malaysia, public cultural/sporting events (PR 4/2015)
ms: 100% dibenarkan bagi proviso (i)–(viii), cth. keraian pekerja (jamuan tahunan, lawatan, hari keluarga), keraian yang dijual dalam perniagaan biasa, sampel promosi, hadiah pameran dagang di luar Malaysia, acara budaya/sukan awam (PR 4/2015)

blocks.en: The slides list (e) and (g) with identical wording, and skip (h). I show them as given.
blocks.ms: Slaid menyenaraikan (e) dan (g) dengan perkataan sama, dan melangkau (h). Saya tunjuk seperti diberi.

blocks.en: These come from the PR files in your TAX2 folder and explain the adjustments used in the lecturer’s worked answers.
blocks.ms: Ini datang daripada fail PR dalam folder TAX2 anda dan menerangkan pelarasan yang digunakan dalam jawapan kerja pensyarah.

en: Wholly and exclusively incurred: 50% allowed, but 100% for the provisos of para 39(1)(l) such as employee entertainment. Lecturer’s Eco Furniture: supplier dinners 50% (RM25,000 added back of RM50,000), staff lunches and annual staff trip fully allowed
ms: Ditanggung sepenuhnya dan semata-mata: 50% dibenarkan, tetapi 100% bagi proviso para 39(1)(l) seperti keraian pekerja. Eco Furniture pensyarah: makan malam pembekal 50% (RM25,000 ditambah semula daripada RM50,000), makan tengah hari staf dan lawatan tahunan staf dibenarkan penuh

en: Revenue and realised: taxable / deductible. Revenue and unrealised: not taxable / deductible. Capital, realised or not: not taxable / deductible. E.g. realised loss on trade debtors allowed; unrealised loss on year-end trade debts added back; realised loss on buying machinery added back
ms: Hasil dan telah direalisasi: boleh dicukai / ditolak. Hasil dan belum direalisasi: tidak boleh dicukai / ditolak. Modal, direalisasi atau tidak: tidak boleh dicukai / ditolak. Cth. kerugian direalisasi atas penghutang dagangan dibenarkan; kerugian belum direalisasi atas hutang dagangan akhir tahun ditambah semula; kerugian direalisasi atas pembelian mesin ditambah semula

en: Theft or embezzlement by an employee is deductible (arising from delegating duties); not deductible where the person is a director or controller. Lecturer’s Styles: Finance Director RM92,000 added back, cashier RM15,000 allowed
ms: Kecurian atau penyelewengan oleh pekerja boleh ditolak (berpunca daripada pemberian tugas); tidak boleh ditolak jika pelaku pengarah atau pengawal. Styles pensyarah: Pengarah Kewangan RM92,000 ditambah semula, juruwang RM15,000 dibenarkan

en: A trade debt written off after reasonable recovery steps is deductible; a provision is not an expense, except s34(2) allows a reasonable provision for trade debts estimated irrecoverable (specific). Non-trade debts such as loans to employees or advances are not deductible unless the business is lending. Recoveries of deducted debts are gross income
ms: Hutang dagangan dihapus kira selepas langkah pungutan munasabah boleh ditolak; peruntukan bukan perbelanjaan, kecuali s34(2) membenarkan peruntukan munasabah bagi hutang dagangan dianggar tidak boleh dipungut (khusus). Hutang bukan dagangan seperti pinjaman pekerja atau pendahuluan tidak boleh ditolak kecuali perniagaan memberi pinjaman. Perolehan semula hutang yang ditolak ialah pendapatan kasar

en: Restoring to the original condition without improvement is revenue; replacing with higher-quality material is an improvement (capital); initial repairs to make an asset usable are capital

blocks.en: Each final computation below follows slide 4 and has three number columns: RM (+) for amounts added, RM (−) for amounts deducted, and RM (total) for the running subtotals. Every item is listed by name. The four bands run from net profit to adjusted income, statutory income, aggregate income and total / chargeable income. Where an item does not apply I write Nil, so you can see that it was considered. Method 2 (start from net profit) is used because the question gives the accounts.
blocks.ms: Setiap pengiraan akhir di bawah mengikut slaid 4 dan mempunyai tiga lajur angka: RM (+) untuk jumlah ditambah, RM (−) untuk jumlah ditolak, dan RM (jumlah) untuk subjumlah berjalan. blocks.en: Order of the computation: profit before tax, take off non-business income, add back disallowed items, deduct further (double) deductions, then capital allowances (and balancing charges), losses brought forward, other statutory income, donations, and the rate. blocks.ms: Urutan pengiraan: keuntungan sebelum cukai, tolak pendapatan bukan perniagaan, tambah balik item tidak dibenarkan, tolak potongan tambahan (berganda), kemudian elaun modal (dan caj imbangan), kerugian dibawa ke hadapan, pendapatan berkanun lain, derma dan kadar. blocks.en: Interest: Maybank interest credited monthly in the year is taxed now. The Affin fixed deposit matured on 15 July 2026, after year end, so the 9,000 is taxed in YA2027 (interest is taxed when it is due and paid, not when it accrues); the sheet taxed it in YA2026. The dividends (pioneer and single tier) are exempt. (b) Management and control: a company is resident in Malaysia if its management and control are exercised in Malaysia, which is normally where the directors’ meetings that make the key decisions are held.
Two advantages of resident status:
1. SME rates of 15% and 17% on the first RM600,000 are for resident companies (paid-up capital not above RM2.5 million); a non-resident pays 24%.
2. Tax incentives under the ITA and the Promotion of Investments Act, group relief for losses and the benefit of double taxation agreements are open to residents; payments to a non-resident are subject to withholding tax, which a resident does not suffer on payments to it.
(The sheet’s second point, about dividends of non-resident companies not being derived from Malaysia, is not an advantage of residence. The sheet also lists four points when two were asked.)

Dua kelebihan status residen:
1. Kadar PKS 15% dan 17% atas RM600,000 pertama untuk syarikat residen (modal berbayar tidak melebihi RM2.5 juta); bukan residen membayar 24%.
2. Insentif cukai di bawah ITA dan Akta Menggalakkan Pelaburan, pelepasan kumpulan untuk kerugian dan manfaat perjanjian cukai berganda terbuka kepada residen; bayaran kepada bukan residen tertakluk kepada cukai pegangan balik, yang tidak dikenakan atas bayaran kepada residen.
